instruction: Candid outdoor over-the-shoulder medium shot of friends interacting in a sunny park with green grass and background trees. In the left foreground, the woman with dark hair tied back (R4) in a dark blue t-shirt stands with her back to the camera, raising her right hand for a high-five. In the center-right, the Black woman with an afro (R6) in a red t-shirt looks surprised with wide eyes and an open mouth, raising her hand to return the high-five. In the background on the left, the East Asian man in a red polo shirt (R3) stands smiling and watching them. Bright, natural sunlight filters through the trees, casting soft shadows on the vibrant green lawn.
elements: R4 initiates the high-five by raising her right hand toward R6
R6 returns R4's high-five with her own raised hand
R3 is a background observer watching R4 and R6 rather than joining the high-five
R4 has her back to the camera while R6 faces her with a surprised expression
The interaction takes place in a sunny park with green grass and background trees
